title: Wright supply-to-price reduced form
content: Figure 7.10's simultaneous system reduced in the direction stated by the source: Demand-to-Price-to-Supply is replaced by Demand-to-Supply, so Yield per Acre instruments Supply for the effect of Supply on Price.

variables.name: Supply
variables.content: The treatment in this direction-specific reduction.

variables.name: Price
variables.content: The outcome in this direction-specific reduction.

arrows.because: Figure 7.10 and its prose make Yield per Acre directly affect Supply.
Figure 7.10 makes Demand directly affect Price.
The source explicitly replaces Demand-to-Price-to-Supply by this reduced-form arrow.
This directional reduction retains the Supply-to-Price causal coefficient.
